scope: Formalize a candidate analytical contribution in phase3; no scheduler retuning or final-test access
known_before_work: All results through the326-definition budget/coverage diagnostic are known. Original history bound uses d-tau as a reset anchor. Its strict refinement over the adjacent-pair count is already established; originality remains unresolved.
proof_review: State complete finite-trace, half-open endpoint, initialization and non-Zeno sampling assumptions. Check whether a forced occupied observation gives the stronger subsequent free-run start bound d rather than d-tau. Check a recursive sufficient reset: an occupied interval of length>=tau is forced if its start c satisfies c-r<=A. Preserve old formulas, source and numerical results.
mathematical_claim: For all causal schedules with global gap<=G, occupied gap<=tau and free gap<=tau until observed-free age A, derive a pathwise missed-episode upper count using guaranteed resets. It is an offline certificate on the supplied reference trace, not an online occupancy estimator, an exact miss-existence decision or a guarantee for unseen physical events.
independent_check: New finite integer-grid dynamic program explores EVERY allowed next pause1..current cap, not only one fixed scheduler. Enumerate five alternating intervals with durations1,2,3, both initial states, at starts0 and1, for parameter triples(tau,G,A)=(2,3,2),(2,4,4),(3,5,5);2916 traces/parameter-start cases (243 duration tuples times2 initial states times2 starts times3 parameter triples). Also200 seeded six-interval examples, both arbitrary starts and full-window uniform upper bounds. Save a maximizing witness; verify its miss count independently. These finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof for real time.
strictness_and_limits: Include constructed cases separating adjacent-pair, legacy history, end-reset and recursive-reset bounds. Include a positive but unattainable count to show the result is sufficient/conservative. Test equality at B+D=G and p-r=A and necessity of the occupied/early-free gap restrictions.
recorded_data: Frozen C3 parameters tau60,G75,A900 only. Evaluate old and new certificate counts at full-window starts on original training256, tuning128, check256 and check512, both>=7day and>=1day windows. All are previously used development BayIds. No policy outcomes or parameters selected from these new counts.
literature: Read the relevant full-text definitions/theorems and declared scope of sampling-invariance and measurement-uncertainty work, including Furia/Rossi2010 and Mehrabian etal2023; compare with S2/S7/S8/S12/S13. Search specifically for state/observed-age dependent finite-trace coverage certificates, not generic IoT. Record exact text scope, primary URLs and hashes. A missing identical hit is not proof of world novelty.
deliverables: Formal method/proof, exact-source comparison and qualified originality verdict, reproducible code/results/tests, one compact Markdown brief for the supervisor and at most one explanatory scientific figure. Do not send messages to the supervisor or modify Google Docs/Canva.
decision: Report an author-derived, narrowly scoped analytical candidate only if proof and falsification survive. Distinguish it from a new superior scheduler. Keep phase4 closed until the contribution claim and full final protocol are defensible; no automatic promotion from finite checks or absence of a search hit.
